method: Final M24 only, same frozen camera/climate, 480×320 SwiftShader. 20 alternating gl.finish render + per-frame effect CPU samples. Active camp uses real installation and seated rig, not a gameplay video. Footprint allocation replays actual confirmed native contacts for render-cost measurement only. These are incremental costs, separate from M23 baseline comparisons.

allocation.method: Instrumented WebGL2 bufferData/deleteBuffer and texture storage/mipmap/delete calls. Logical storage, texture estimate with depth24 conservatively counted as 4 B/texel. Excludes driver/compression/framebuffer defaults; not physical VRAM.
